import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
p=json.loads(Path('schema/step28_alias_test_policy.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for rec in [p['data']['manifest'],p['data']['validation'],*p['data']['inputs'].values()]:
    path=Path(rec['path'])
    row={'path':rec['path'],'exists':path.is_file(),'expected_bytes':rec['bytes'],'expected_sha256':rec['sha256']}
    if path.is_file():
        actual=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        row.update(bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=actual,match=(path.stat().st_size==rec['bytes'] and actual==rec['sha256']))
    rows.append(row)
print(json.dumps({'time':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'operation':'metadata and byte hashing only; no text or labels parsed','files':rows}))
